raw_text:
name: dotnet-upgrade
Analyze projects/.csproj targets, SDKs, dependencies, packages.config, ordering, rollback, Upgrade Assistant/manual migration, net8.0, modernization, async, APIs, NuGet, transitive conflicts. Update YAML `UseDotNet@2`, `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 CI pipelines, tests, telemetry, UAT/production validation. Plan branches, PRs, reviews, documentation, dashboards, artifacts, release notes, multi-repo checks. Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, `graph.json`.
